endpoint_relax_correction_2026_06_16.fix: relax_right.py: FixAtoms(z<25.6 bottom slab), ASE BFGS fmax=0.02, QE gpu pw.x (k221, ecutwfc 60/ecutrho 480, PBE). Repeated foreground-session kills -> restarted from last traj frame via setsid (session-independent); ran to convergence.

result.interpretation: on_N_right is NOT equivalent to on_N_left — it is a metastable Li adatom site +0.614 eV higher. The hop is therefore ASYMMETRIC (forward vs reverse barriers differ by 0.614 eV). Record as physics, not artifact (down from the +0.848 rigid-shift value once relaxed).
